about_the_game:
• A Tapestry of Realms — Venture through richly themed regions: from the mossy Fernlight Grove to the ancient ruins of a fallen tample and the Forest Canopies. Each area weaves narrative threads, environmental puzzles, and combat challenges.

  • Satisfying Souls‑like Combat — Precision dodges, weighty strikes, and reactive enemy designs demand you master your timing. Evade, counter, adapt.

  • Useful Mechanics — As Evan gains new powers, the world of Celestial Lumina opens up, allowing for further exploration towards the skies.

  • Talismans, Relics & Custom Builds — Equip 5+ relics each with unique effects (e.g. phase‑stone, stardrop, thorn seeds). Mix and match to find your ideal playstyle.

  • Narrative Depth & Choices — Meet ancient guardians, celestial exiles, and enigmatic puppeteers. Dialogue choices and lore exploration shape your understanding of the conflict.

  • Intricate Level Design — Expect clever shortcuts, hidden vaults, branching paths, secret chambers, and reward exploration.

  • Atmospheric Audio & Pixel Art — A beautiful yet haunting soundtrack and detailed, hand-crafted pixel environments amplify the mood of light struggling against overwhelming darkness.

name: Celestial Lumina Demo
short_description: Step into the role of Evan, a young warrior caught between Heaven and the Underworld, as he’s thrust into a collapsing world where divine order has shattered. In Celestial Lumina, you’ll journey through haunting landscapes, uncover hidden truths, and fight to restore balance in an eternal night.
